question.text: Category III AIFs offering a 'Direct Plan' to investors must ensure that:

answer.text: Direct plans carry higher management fees to compensate for no distributor
Direct plans carry no distribution fee or placement fee
Direct plans are available only for LVFs
Direct plans cannot be offered; only distributor channels are permitted

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the Series-XIX-B workbook, a Direct Plan for Category III AIFs should not entail any distribution fee or placement fee. The same page also requires that investors approached through a fee-charging SEBI-registered intermediary be onboarded via the Direct Plan. The Trap: Direct Plans are not restricted to LVFs and are not prohibited; the rule is about removing distribution/placement fees in the Direct Plan, not about denying its availability or raising management fees. Note: Source: page 117 of the Series-XIX-B workbook, which sets out the Direct Plan option, the no-distribution/placement-fee requirement, and onboarding of fee-charging intermediary investors via the Direct Plan.
